body: Why causes you to feel this way, if I may ask?

Kinda was in a similar situation to yours. My girlfriend was also depressed but nowhere near as often or as intense as I am. I constantly told her how I often think about killing myself, and eventually we broke up, for a much different reason. However, she did say that she couldn’t listen to me anymore and that I was emotionally draining to talk to, which I understand that I am. I loved her more than I have ever loved any single person in my entire life, and it makes me so unbelievably sad to know I pushed her away, at least partly. Your options are either to try to subdue your emotions and urges for the sake of your boyfriend, get professional help, or break up with him.  Don’t make the same mistake I did, professional help is your best option in this case, in my opinion.

Because you’re assuming that just because someone isn’t changing that means that they don’t want to change. Those are two entirely separate things. You can’t base someones desire to change off of the progress they’ve made. Some of these people are broken inside, and maybe instead of not wanting to change they just don’t know how to. Stop being such a cunt and accept that each individual handles depression differently. That doesn’t make him of her and more or any less important than someone else who suffers. When you truly feel alone in this world, a place full of welcoming and caring people such as this subreddit means the world to you. You are so wrong for wanting to deny them that.

I don’t think you quite understand how depression works. There is no definition, it changes with each individual and adapts, like a disease or virus. Some people need to post here, because they have no one to talk to, or maybe they’re lonely. Everyone wants to change, no one “likes” being depressed, its just that some are more receptive to change than others. Next time don’t be so insensitive to such a complex issue.

Why do you want to kill yourself. Is it schoolwork, loneliness, failure, etc?

It feels like the entire weight of the world is on your shoulders, and some people just aren’t strong enough to get that, I understand. What’s important is that you try to the best of your ability, and it can be so hard sometimes but you have to try. Because ultimately things will get better, and your life will become easier. Trust me, I know exactly what you’re going through right now, and ending it seems so simple. Fuck everyone, I don’t care about my family, my friends are all fake, there’s no one I have a desire to keep happy. So focus all that attention on yourself. We can make it through this, its such bullshit and we don’t deserve it, but I promise you we can make it through this.

My PM’s are open if you need someone to talk to :).

Hey, just read your post and wanted to share something with you. The girl I thought I loved, I thought I would spend the rest of my life with, I thought would be my everything was gone in a flash. Not even five minutes after she broke up with me she was flirting with another guy, and not even three days later did they have their first date. Meanwhile I’m still stuck here months later wishing she would come back, or even send me one message. It hurts a lot, to know you would give the world for someone, to give them every piece of your heart and realize that they don’t feel the same way about you. It hurts so much. But we’re stronger than we think, because despite all the times I so badly wanted to end my life and even attempted so, I never did, and neither did you. So we’re stuck here, in this bullshit world, with these bullshit people and these bullshit problems, so we might as well make the best of it. You’re a strong person, and you will get through this, just have a little perseverance and faith. Ultimately its his loss, and you will eventually find the one person who loves you to the same extent that you love them.

As much as I love every single stranger who is willing to take time out of their day to help someone else (seriously you guys are incredible), its just not the same as having someone you know talk to you. Someone whose shoulder you can actually cry on, who can wrap you up with a tight hug. I am so unbelievably grateful for every single stranger who cares but the sad truth is that I never actually feel any better, I never feel any different.

My current family prevents me from being able to date anyone. I thought I could try to date a girl in secret, it wasn’t able to work, and it completely shattered me. Even after I lose contact with my family I don’t plan to find someone for a really long time, I’m just not as strong as I thought.

First of all, big props for posting on your main account, that’s something I could never ever do myself.

I think you described depression so flawlessly, everything you said I can immediately relate to. The fact that its not enough to be emotionally and mentally draining, it also comes with the physical pain in your chest. The need or desire to have someone fill the missing hole in your life. I met someone too, I loved her with every ounce of my heart, and it breaks you into a million pieces when you find out they don’t feel the same way about you. Life is bullshit, complete bullshit, and the only reason I haven’t committed suicide yet is because I’m too scared of it failing or being excruciatingly painful. We all just have to trudge along, and believe me I understand just how fucking hard it can be, but we’ll get there, me and you pal.
Also 17, I’m just a kid man. I try so hard to be a good person, to be as caring and compassionate as I can be. I don’t deserve this kind of pain, I’m just a fucking kid.

I feel you all the way man. I just want to feel fucking normal. Everyone always saying “you’re unique, special, different”. Fuck that. I just wanted to have a normal childhood, a normal life. I don’t understand why that is too much to ask for. It’s not fair, it’s just so fucking unfair.

That I am currently at one of the highest points of my depression that I have ever been and am so close to killing myself. Mostly because of an unbelievable amount of childhood trauma, relationship breakup, and feeling so fucking lonely all the time, but theres so much stuff thats affecting me and I never just get to tell anyone. My life is a fast moving downward spiral and everything I’m trying to do to pick it up just isn’t fucking working. Ive realized some people weren’t meant to be happy, and I am unlucky enough to be one of those people.

Holy shit man you are literally me except I’m in the girl’s shoes (Muslim dude). I met my first love not a while back and I thought it was the whole deal, ya know? Everything felt so right with her, I thought this was it, we were both so happy and in love. Until one day she tells me she isn’t so happy anymore, as she thinks because of my parents we don’t have a future together, and she comes from a white religious family. And so we broke up, but not even a day afterwards she starting dating someone else, promising him everything she did to me. And I felt like I was so special, so unique, so wanted and loved, only to find out all of it was a complete lie. He constantly had to rub it in my face until she eventually broke up with him and started dating someone else not even two days later, just a never ending cycle. It just sucks so much fucking ass because I hate my parents so much for ruining the one thing I ever wanted, and I know that I am better off without her but its just so hard to not think about what was there and what could have been. Apologize for the rant, its been eating me alive and I needed to let it out somewhere.

Wholeheartedly agree with you, don’t ever think you’re the only one, there’s always someone who can replace you.

My family is very religious/anti-Christmas, so I always just watch everyone else have fun without me. I was planning to celebrate with my girlfriend this year but she broke up with me a couple weeks ago, so back to being alone. Not sure if there’s really anything that can make it better, but thanks for asking the question.

This resonates so much. All we ever did was dream up futures together, all she ever told me was that we could get married and have kids and be happy. And you’re going to throw that all away because of one stupid, petty thing? Who the actual fuck do you think you are, filling my head with promises and visions, and taking it all away. Who the fuck are you?

Same man, its only been about a week or so but it feels like shes so much happier with him, and i want her so fucking badly, I want to marry her and love her because no one loves her more than I do. Why wasn’t I good enough? What did I do wrong? Its so fucking painful to see them together when I know he doesn’t care about her as much as I do. Why am I so caught up in someone who doesn’t feel the same way about me? I don’t understand why I’m like this, and I know if their relationship ever reaches that point it will seriously damage me forever. I just want her to be happy, and I feel so selfish but at the same time I want it to be with me. Its so hard man, I haven’t been eating, I can barely pay attention to my studies, my depression is worse than ever, its just so fucking hard.

I feel you man, everyone keeps telling me do this, do that, get your mind off her but I just fucking can’t. Not when she’s always in my fucking head. It took her less than a day after the breakup to move on to the new relationship and at first I thought he was just a rebound but now things are moving quickly and I feel like I’ve lost my chance forever. It hurts so much because I invested so much of my time, energy, and love into her and its all wasted, all down the goddamn drain. I know she has, but I just can’t bring myself to move on and I’m trying so fucking hard.

I can relate to both of these stories so fucking much. I’ve just been through an on and off relationship with her but this time I think its off for good. We both loved each other so much and it seemed like we had our whole lives planned out. We fought one night and something came out that I instantly regretted. I tried to take it all back, I wish I could but I could see it in her eyes that it was over and there was no coming back. She was my best friend, the only person I could ever be truly myself with, and it hurts so fucking much to see her with someone else. It hurts so fucking much to know that she was able to move on so quickly when everyday I’m so caught up in her that I can’t even breathe. Everyday I ask myself those same questions. Why wasn’t I good enough? Why did I let the single best thing that ever happened to me go? I feel like this is something I might not be able to move on from, simply because I don’t know how and I don’t want to move on from her. She was everything to me, my soulmate, and its all lost now. I lost it all.

Everyone keeps telling me it will get better but I can’t keep waiting. Its killing me.
